estimand.population: synthetic subjects entering a 21-day observation window
estimand.treatment_or_exposure: at least one observed exposure to the target channel before a qualifying conversion or horizon end
estimand.intervention: set target-channel exposure indicator to 1 while holding declared observable adjustment covariates fixed
estimand.comparison: set target-channel exposure indicator to 0 while holding declared observable adjustment covariates fixed
estimand.temporal_ordering: eligible target-channel exposure must precede the qualifying conversion; otherwise it is outside the treatment definition
estimand.treatment_regime: single-channel binary exposure intervention evaluated separately for each channel
estimand.aggregation_target: population-average risk-difference vector, one incremental conversion-probability estimate per channel

hypothesis.statement: An interpretable covariate-adjusted linear-probability treatment-effect estimator can reduce synthetic causal-recovery error under selection bias relative to unadjusted descriptive attribution behavior, when observed cross-channel exposure patterns contain useful proxies for selection.
why_it_might_address_selection: Other observed channel-exposure indicators can proxy part of latent purchase intent when intent influences exposure to several channels.
Jointly adjusting for measured co-exposures separates part of target-channel selection from outcome association.
The target coefficient remains an interpretable conditional risk-difference estimate rather than normalized conversion credit.
assumptions_required: Conditional exchangeability is approximately achieved by the preregistered observable adjustment set.
Other-channel exposure indicators used for adjustment are not materially downstream mediators of the target exposure in the evaluated world.
There is sufficient overlap/positivity for treated and untreated subjects.
The additive linear conditional-mean approximation is adequate for the population-average target.
Measurement corruption does not completely destroy the adjustment variables.
expected_failure_conditions: Latent intent strongly drives treatment and outcome but is not proxied by observed co-exposures.
Strong treatment interactions or heterogeneous effects dominate the marginal average.
Severe channel-dependent missingness or identity fragmentation distorts the observable adjustment set.
Time-varying treatment effects invalidate the static binary-exposure approximation.
hypothesis.rejection_logic: The hypothesis is rejected if the frozen preregistered Phase 1/holdout criteria fail after development is frozen; no post-holdout tuning is permitted.

method_selection.selected_method: ridge-stabilized linear probability model with heteroskedasticity-robust HC1 intervals
method_selection.rationale: This is the simplest interpretable estimator that directly targets a conversion-probability risk difference while adjusting for observable cross-channel selection proxies. It can represent positive or negative marginal effects, has inspectable coefficients, and does not require black-box sequence learning.

observable_inputs: binary presence of each observed channel in the subject journey
uncertainty_target: 95% heteroskedasticity-robust HC1 confidence interval for each channel risk-difference estimate

development_policy.allowed: development worlds only for implementation, numerical-stability work and fixed regularization selection
development_policy.prohibited: sealed holdout access, holdout-derived tuning, or modification of frozen Phase 1

falsification_plan_status: Thresholds and exact family rules will be frozen after development and before any sealed holdout exposure.
required_public_holdout_disclosure: The holdout-family architecture is public because this is a public research repository. Instantiated holdout seeds, parameter values, treatment effects, latent-intent strengths, interactions, selection mechanisms, and corruption settings remain sealed from candidate development. This provides strong research-process separation but is not equivalent to a completely secret external benchmark.
